subject: 明代江南市场棚（原创扩展）
prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit supplied Song southern asset into a Ming Jiangnan variant. Keep exact camera and realistic low-saturation matte material style and fine detail density. ONE simple open market stall 3m east-west by2m north-south, four wooden posts, low neutral canvas awning sloping evenly, waist-high table with folded woven cloth and two baskets, thin stone footing. Tiny practical market furnishing, no tiled house, no oversized crates, no vendors. Preserve complete isolated shape, no environment. Exact2:1 ground axes +0.5/-0.5, yaw45 pitch30 orthographic, target footprint as listed. Upper-left light, short lower-right contact shadow only. True transparent RGBA cutout with ZERO alpha outside silhouette, NO diffuse glow or fog or halo, no white background. At least10% empty margin around all edges. No text, people, watermark, labels, grid or modern objects. One asset only.
